title: Ghost Setlist
description: A Beatles set as lit lettering on pure black, laid out like a Swiss poster. Flick through it and every song leaves cooling outline afterimages behind it like a long exposure, then lands solid on its baseline.
intent: One kinetic type mechanic finished to the edge: a title whose speed is drawn as long-exposure ghosts, collapsing into a single lit line when it settles, on a clean typographic grid.
